title: Germany
data: 10,754 municipalities, Bundestag elections 2017–2025; full interactive panels

pca.cap: K = 10 voting blocs: The ten blocs of the 2017–2025 fit, numbered by 2025 AfD share. Each GIF turns the same three-dimensional PCA of the municipalities' 2017–2025 Bundestag list-vote shares, coloured by one variable. Immigrants and religion: Zensus 2022 100 m grid summed into the 2025 municipalities; unemployment and purchasing power: INKAR (BBSR) 2023; university degree: INKAR, county level only.

heat.cap: Vote shares in each federal election (columns: party by election), 1,200 sampled municipalities (rows), grouped by bloc. Hover for a row's share; click to pin it.

demog_list.title: AfD share, 2025
demog_list.cap: AfD share of the 2025 list vote (Zweitstimmen). Grey: a small place counted with a neighbour in 2025. Red low, grey the median municipality (22%), blue high; the scale runs from 10% to 51% (2nd to 98th percentile).

demog_list.title: Born abroad
demog_list.cap: Share of residents born outside Germany (Zensus 2022, 100 m grid summed into municipalities). Red low, grey the median municipality (9%), blue high; the scale runs from 1% to 28% (2nd to 98th percentile).

demog_list.title: Roman Catholic
demog_list.cap: Share of residents in the Roman Catholic Church (Zensus 2022). Red low, grey the median municipality (18%), blue high; the scale runs from 1% to 82% (2nd to 98th percentile).

demog_list.title: Protestant
demog_list.cap: Share of residents in a Protestant (EKD) church (Zensus 2022). Red low, grey the median municipality (23%), blue high; the scale runs from 3% to 68% (2nd to 98th percentile).

demog_list.title: Neither Catholic nor Protestant
demog_list.cap: Share of residents of another religion or none (Zensus 2022). Red low, grey the median municipality (38%), blue high; the scale runs from 13% to 88% (2nd to 98th percentile).

demog_list.title: University degree (county)
demog_list.cap: Share of employees, by place of residence, with a university degree (INKAR 2023). County level only: every municipality takes its county's value. Red low, grey the median municipality (12%), blue high; the scale runs from 8% to 24% (2nd to 98th percentile).

demog_list.title: Unemployment
demog_list.cap: Unemployed per 100 residents aged 15–64 (INKAR 2023). Red low, grey the median municipality (3%), blue high; the scale runs from 1% to 8% (2nd to 98th percentile).

demog_list.title: Purchasing power
demog_list.cap: Purchasing power in euros per resident (INKAR 2023, Kaufkraft). Red low, grey the median municipality (€28,900), blue high; the scale runs from €23,300 to €36,500 (2nd to 98th percentile).
